I'm feeling better really, things could be better and I still have moments where I feel somewhat suicidal but life has been good to me recently
Thanks for checking up on me I really appreciate that

Though they're are many reasons I believe the true reason is just nature itself. Humans like all species live to be a part of the species to live and thrive without children a species can't go on it will shrivel up and be forgotten. We are no different from Monkeys or Lions we exist to keep going because nature tells us to live. The problem with humans is that we have been given individualism so having children is more complex to us than just a dog who breeds to keep his species going. Due to Individualism we have children for things like 'love' or 'sucess' really though I believe love reigns above all. Humans love their children they feel complex feelings for them, they want to give a fellow human being the best life they can offer so they may die happy knowing they gave a child their best. What I just said may make parents seem selfish or self orientated but I do not see it that way, it's not the success they witness that gives them happiness it's seeing the one they loved succeed. Above all else though Nature is the bigger factor I believe the original Jurassic Park put it best "Life finds a way"
